infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the Remote Access pair QR from your AtleyOS home server.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: AtleyOS learns people from your contacts on your home server Profile.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: AtleyOS learns routines from your calendar on your home server Profile.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: AtleyOS learns tasks from reminders on your home server Profile.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AtleyOS learns significant places to help you better. Data stays on your home server.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: AtleyOS may learn significant places in the background when you allow it. Data stays on your home server.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AtleyOS learns photo metadata (and media if granted) into your home Profile.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Send voice notes to your AtleyOS home server for transcription and Chat.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock AtleyOS Client before Chat and Actions.
